Mission.eyebrow: Wokim bilong misin long olgeta hap
Mission.headline: Tok i no senis. Pasin bilong ol man long lukluk i senis.
Mission.intro: Mipela i wokim gen laibreri bilong vidio na ol tul bilong mipela stat long as, na mipela i putim planti yia bilong wok bilong tanim tok i go long ol ples we ol man i save bung, lukluk, na serim pinis.
Mission.libraryPointTitle: Laibreri bilong film i gat moa tanim tok long olgeta hap bilong graun
Mission.libraryPointDescription: Planti yia bilong wok bilong tanim tok, wantaim ol pren bilong wok bilong God ol man i trastim, i wokim wanpela laibreri i gat planti tausen tokples, bai ol man i ken bungim stori bilong Jisas long tokples i kisim bel bilong ol tru.
Mission.formatsPointTitle: Kisim ol vois ol man i trastim i go long ol nupela kain vidio
Mission.formatsPointDescription: Mipela i wokim gen pasin bilong autim ol stori bilong gutnius long piksa, na bungim ol tanim tok ol man i trastim wantaim ol nupela kain vidio, bai tok i ken go isi long olgeta ples, kalsa, na skrin.
Mission.teamPointTitle: I winim laibreri tasol. Wanpela tim i wok bilong misin.
Mission.teamPointDescription: Jesus Film Project em i wanpela tim long olgeta hap bilong graun. Long en i gat ol man bilong tanim tok, ol saveman bilong media, ol edita, na ol man bilong wokim samting, na ol i tanim planti yia bilong wok bilong God i kamap ol tul bilong ol man i wokim disaipel long olgeta hap.
Mission.nextStepsDescription: Bungim ol man i lukluk wantaim ol rot tru long wokabaut bilong spirit, bilong helpim ol long kisim neks step i go long komuniti, Baibel, o wok misin.
Mission.mediaLibraryTitle: Laibreri bilong Media bilong Autim Gutnius
Mission.mediaLibraryDescription: Wanpela bikpela laibreri bilong Kristen media i gat planti tausen vidio, film, na ol samting bilong helpim, i stap long planti tokples bilong wok bilong God na bilong autim gutnius long olgeta hap bilong graun.
Mission.ministryToolsTitle: Ol Digital Tul bilong Ol Wok bilong God
Mission.ministryToolsDescription: Ol tul bilong lukautim vidio, salim ol samting i go aut, bungim ol man i lukluk, na lukim ol namba, i kamap bilong helpim ol wok bilong God long kisim planti moa man long gutpela rot.
Mission.inviteHeadline: Helpim wokim {accent} bilong ol tul bilong misin
Mission.inviteBody: Mipela i singautim ol wokman, ol man bilong wokim samting, na ol pren long kam insait pastaim. Traim ol nupela tul pastaim, givim tingting bilong yu, na helpim stretim ol samting mipela i wokim bilong tru wok misin.

Mission.roadmapCardAriaHint: Openim pes bilong wok misin bilong Jesus Film long hap bilong plen bilong bihain
